There was an article a while ago about the Mikveh in the Tel Aviv suburb of Hadar Yosef - the owner said they would allow non-Orthodox to use it - you could try with them :) https://www.mikveh.co.il/%D7%9E%D7%A7%D7%95%D7%95%D7%90%D7%95%D7%AA/%D7%9E%D7%A7%D7%95%D7%95%D7%94-%D7%94%D7%93%D7%A8-%D7%99%D7%95%D7%A1%D7%A3-%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91/  https://www.bhol.co.il/news/767542

Otherwise, you can use the sea as a Mikveh - it is totally kosher (so long as you follow all the instructions to the letter). You have to swim out in your swimwear and take it off while you are in the water.
